In this section we are going to learn about divide and conquer algorithm.
Basically, before we have covered the algorithms which use the divide and conquer approach, we are
going to look at them how they are using divide and conquer algorithm as well.
And we will solve the new problems using divide and conquer algorithm.
Now what does divide and conquer algorithm means?
By definition, divide and conquer is an algorithm design paradigm which works recursively, breaking
down a problem into the subproblem of similar type until this becomes simple enough to be solved directly.
Then, after solving the subproblems, we can combine them together to the original problem.
This means that if the given problem can be broken into smaller, simpler problems.
In that case, divide and conquer approach can be used.
So here we have three steps.
First we are dividing the problem into the subproblems.
Then we are solving that subproblems.
Then we are combining them together.
Then we are combining them together to form the final solution.
So in programming, let's say we were asked to develop a website.
So in this case, to develop it we need to divide this project into smaller modules.
So let's say we divide it in this case into three modules design front end development and back end
development.
Now when it comes to the design, we can divide design also into subproblems, which is UI, UX design,
visual design and responsive design.
Then we can divide the front end development into the structure, styling and interactivity part for
back end.
Also, we can divide it into architecture, implementation, testing and security.
So after solving these subproblems one by one, at the end we will get the final solution, which is
a complete website.
Now the logic behind the divide and conquer is working like this.
So let's say we have a problem like this.

Now we are dividing it until the step that we cannot divide it further.
So in this case let's say we cannot divide it after this subproblem.
So we are going to solve them and combine them to the solution to do this subproblem.
So after solving that we are going to combine them to the subproblem solution.
Then we are going to combine this solution to the main problem.
Then we are going to combine these solutions for the solution to the main problem.
So as you can see we are dividing into the subproblems, then solving subproblems and combining them
together.
Finding out the big solution.
